entries.reason: the release carries the whole of vDSP from 4.3, so nothing is built beside it: this is one conversion of the release's own 24-bit type, and every release that has the function has the type it converts
entries.effect: C[n] = (float)A[n] over the 24-bit reader, with the strides given; a 24-bit value is three bytes least significant first, sign-extended from bit 23 for the signed reader and not for the unsigned one; measured, the signed reader of 8388607, -8388608 and -12345 answers those three and the unsigned reader the same three as 8388607, 8388608 and 16777215
entries.source: the host's own vDSP, held against the port for every case by tests/backports/host/vdsp, which runs the port's vDSPFixed7.m and vDSPElementwise8.m and the host's vDSP over the same inputs; the header of iOS 16.4 for the declarations; the release's own armv7 caches for 4.3, 5.1.1, 6.0, 6.1.3, 7.0, 7.1.2, 8.0 and 9.3.6, which say which release first exports each name and are the release the two files answer to
